summary: John's 6th-great-grandmother per the tree (mother of Mary Young Croup); her Doll parentage is unproven.
bio: The tree shows Anna Maria Doll (1751-1813), wife of John Young Sr., as daughter of 'Johann C Doll Captain' and Anna M. Dietz. No record names her. Casper Doll's known daughters are Hannah (b.1742), Elizabeth (1753-1829, m. Christopher Stecher) and Anna Catharine (bapt. 1757, Tohickon). The Stechers also married into the Grubs, so these Forks Twp families overlapped. That an Anna Maria Doll b. 1751 was Casper's daughter is 'probable but unproven' (pa_lines) / 'unproven' (Round 1).
